latest.headline: scagliox01 Claims Estonia Victory
latest.paragraph: scagliox01 has triumphed in the Estonia round of the JWRC, finishing the eight-stage event with a total time of 00:36:35.839. Securing 39 total points, including four from the Power Stage, scagliox01 fended off a challenge from runner-up Flinnowaty, who finished 18.353 seconds behind. SubaruNyx rounded out the podium despite taking four stage wins throughout the event. With 26 drivers starting the rally, four drivers were recorded as DNF. This result strengthens scagliox01’s position in the career standings, building on previous performances in the season as the competition remains intense.
